design: Swiss-Editorial typographic expression, off-white black and electric lime accents, oversized grid/typographic hierarchy, photo/typography cadence and unusually beautiful long-form project writing. Not templated resume or small card list.
signatureFeatures: Rich case storytelling with problem, constraints, process, decisions and deliverables
Portfolio filters by sector/service and a true grid/list mode
Interactive image annotations and before/after concept rationale
Project brief intake with scope/budget/timeline and matching service preselection
Bilingual opinionated essays linked to services and work
seedRequirements: 12 projects with 4 unique discipline narratives, 7 service packages, 6 thought articles, 12 galleries, 8 FAQs, 3 inquiry scenarios.
adminRequirements: Cases, services, asset annotations, journals, pages and inquiry queue; editor can reorder case sections and preview AR/EN before publishing. All public claims marked concept.
